title: A Comparison of Seroquel vs. Risperidone in Schizophrenia
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to show equal efficacy of both quetiapine and risperidone in subjects treated with study medication for up to 8 weeks.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria

* Male / Female, 18-65 years old
* Schizophrenia (as per DSM IV)

Exclusion Criteria

* Concurrent use of psychotropic medication
* Does not fulfill moderately ill on CGI
